scenarios.name: 2 admins toggle concurrent — last-write-wins
scenarios.expected: Last DB write wins; both broadcasts emitted in order; clients reconcile to final state.
scenarios.evidence: AvailabilityController writes through Eloquent model save → DB ACID guarantees serialization. Both ItemAvailabilityChanged events fire via DispatchableAfterCommit. Frontend re-fetches catalog-overview to converge.
scenarios.verdict: GREEN — last-write-wins is the documented contract; no fiscal exposure (not NF525).

scenarios.name: Toggle during checkout — 422 quote re-validate
scenarios.expected: Kiosk cart with an item that becomes unavailable mid-checkout → POST /api/customer/orders/quote returns 422 with composition step missing; kiosk prompts user to re-select.
scenarios.evidence: PricingService::calculateOrder is SSOT (CLAUDE.md §8); composition_snapshot frozen at order creation. Pre-create quote re-validates against current branch availability. If ItemBranchAvailability.is_available=false at quote time → validator rejects.
scenarios.verdict: GREEN — pricing SSOT + composition_snapshot frozen pattern protects vs. mid-checkout flip.

scenarios.name: Multi-tenant cross-branch leak — BranchScope enforcement
scenarios.expected: Staff with branch_id=2 calling /api/admin/menu/availability/toggle for item bound to branch_id=1 → 404 or 403 (cannot see other branch).
scenarios.evidence: BranchScope global scope on ItemBranchAvailability (Model line 41) + auth:sanctum + Spatie permission:items_edit. Branch resolution from session user; cross-branch query returns empty set → 404. Admin (branch_id=0) bypass intentional (CLAUDE.md §9).
scenarios.verdict: GREEN — defense-in-depth scope + perm + session-tied branch.

findings.title: Stock-rupture dashboard SSOT line broadcast — verify cache-key uniformity across multi-instance
findings.issue: V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL uses single-instance file driver; cache invalidation is local. CLAUDE.md §8 cache-driver guard at AppServiceProvider:215 only rejects 'array'/'null' (file/database PASS). UNI-03 V1.0.X backlog tracked. NOT a V1 ship blocker.
findings.v102_action: Widen forbidden cache drivers list before ALB multi-instance cutover.

findings.title: stock_movements UPDATE/DELETE triggers MySQL-only without TRUNCATE GRANT-REVOKE — partial coverage gap
findings.where: database/migrations/2026_05_18_140000_*.php — triggers exist on MySQL + SQLite parity. TRUNCATE bypass documented as 'mitigated via GRANT-level REVOKE on audit_logs + z_reports' (CLAUDE.md §8) — but stock_movements does NOT appear in CVP0-1 (Ansible f840c3ef5) REVOKE list.
findings.issue: TRUNCATE TABLE stock_movements would bypass triggers without the GRANT-REVOKE pattern that protects audit_logs + z_reports. stock_movements is NOT NF525-fiscal (per migration comment lines 23-25) so prison-time risk is zero; but for V1.0.2 audit completeness this should be extended.
findings.v1_action: none (table marked NF525-adjacent only; cascadeOnDelete from items/branches is the real cleanup path)
findings.v102_action: Add stock_movements to GRANT REVOKE ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE list in cloud-prep Ansible CVP0-1 follow-on.

summary: SYS-F STOCK ULTIMATE — full coverage 7-dim GREEN. Items list (11) + Edit form + Ingredients list (15) + Stock Rupture Dashboard (12 cat tabs, SSOT broadcast tagline, EN STOCK switches) all rendered clean. Broadcast chain ItemAvailabilityChanged → BumpMenuSnapshot + InvalidateKioskMenuCache verified via EventServiceProvider:216-221. HEAL-2 NotifyStockLowOnStockLevelChanged active with sentinel pin (no double-broadcast). web-guard ingredients_manage perm gate on ALL ingredient CRUD. BranchScope on ItemBranchAvailability (line 41) + 20-model sentinel coverage. stock_movements no_update + no_delete triggers (MySQL+SQLite parity). Adversarial 3-vector GREEN (last-write-wins + 422 mid-checkout + BranchScope defense-in-depth). 3 findings P2/P3 backlog only, 0 V1 ship blocker. No frozen-zone touch.
